      A count of incoming mail accounts using OAuth2 for authentication, keyed
      by OAuth2 issuer.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Account reporting groups incoming OAuth2 accounts by the provider issuer returned by hostname details. It excludes accounts that are not configured for OAuth2 or have no valid provider details. Different configured mail hosts can share one issuer. oauth2ProviderCount is a labeled_string snapshot: accumulate counts in a Map, then set each issuer value. The label is an issuer, not a display brand or the configured hostname. Do not turn this startup snapshot into repeated counter additions.
title: Use the OAuth2 issuer as the account telemetry key
